environment.receiver: Apple Silicon macOS 27.0.1, native Flutter client, ru.boohtacord.localqa
environment.transport: owned loopback Go/PostgreSQL/LiveKit; two synthetic participants; both microphones muted

before_fix.initial_visual_observation: Native macOS displayed the entire Android portrait at 576x1280. A short diagnostics sample showed about 12 decoded FPS under the selected 720p15 profile; this is not a sustained cadence or capacity acceptance.
before_fix.reconnect: FAIL: Android texture visible, waiting-first-frame overlay and retry button remained; receiver observation decoded one frame and first_frame_rendered=false.
before_fix.sender_counters: Available when the macOS viewer subscribed; absence with no viewer is not independently a confirmed defect.
before_fix.interrupted: Android device disappeared at the end of the initial run; no normal stop/release acceptance is claimed.
before_fix.initial_attempt_isolation: An unintended receiver-side publication was removed by stopping only owned QA receiver instances before the isolated Android-only observation.

fix.reason: VideoTrackRenderer layout/resize rebuild reattached the identical media stream, incrementing native sourceGeneration and rejecting its queued first-frame event.
fix.implementation: Install the callback before attaching; attach only when the media stream object changes.
fix.regression: RED: native first-frame callback count 0 instead of 1 after resize. GREEN: first frame accepted without reattachment; replacement source gets a new generation and old frames remain rejected.

checks.desktop_browser_failure: connection-status locator not found during the media-fault stage, 5 second timeout; saved as FAIL without retrying it to green.

remaining.fixed_paired_media_runtime: PARTIAL PASS: native first frame and advancing decode counters verified; moving timer, repeated reopen and clean stop still need visual acceptance.
remaining.moving_timer_and_sustained_15fps: NOT_PASS: timer visual comparison pending; sampled decoding averaged about 10fps under 720p15.

after_fix.source: same candidate source on Android and macOS, based on d6f9ce74 with uncommitted renderer correction; exact published-master pair remains unverified
after_fix.native_receiver_first_frame: PASS: full Android portrait appeared without the waiting-first-frame overlay; first_frame_rendered=true with subscribed remote screen and no local receiver publication
after_fix.rendered_frame_counter: Unavailable from native receiver stats; no numeric rendered-frame claim
after_fix.selected_profile: 720p15; observed mean does not demonstrate 15fps acceptance
after_fix.initial_attempt_isolation: Unintended receiver-side publication stopped before the Android-only viewing interval; contaminated initial interval excluded
after_fix.visual_followup: BLOCKED: Mac locked again before confirming the moving HTML timer, viewer reopen, app-only and normal stop.
